statements.status_notes: netty-transport-native-kqueue provides Netty's kqueue native transport for macOS and BSD. The neo4j images run on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, where Netty never loads the kqueue transport (it selects epoll or the NIO transport), so the vulnerable code path is unreachable in this image. The corresponding linux native transport (netty-transport-native-epoll) is patched to 4.2.15.Final.
